S38.01.needs: a Free account or a paid account
S38.01.note: The sidebar item is marked hideable, so a user who hid it will not see it; the teaching behaviour comes from the study instruction in apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/request-processor.ts (studyInstruction), not the plan's cited line 2892.
steps: Sign in and click "Study" in the sidebar (or click the + button under the chat box and choose "Study").
On the page titled "Study", type a subject in "What are you studying?", keep the "How" choice, and click "Start studying".
Wait for the chat to open. Look for the "Studying: <your subject>" indicator above the chat, and check that the tutor teaches one idea at a time and asks a question before moving on.

labels.text: Start with a personal study plan

S38.02.note: The page has no separate goal screen; the typed subject and the How choice together stand in for stating a learning goal before the session starts.
steps: Under "Start a session", click in the field "What are you studying?" and type a goal such as eigenvalues. The field stops at 200 characters.
Choose one option under "How": "Learn it", "Practise it" or "Revise it". Each shows a one-line description.
Optionally tick "Start with a personal study plan", then click "Start studying". Check that the chat opens and the first reply is about your goal.
S38.02.where: Sidebar > Study > "What are you studying?" and "How"

S38.03.needs: none (a project is needed to see the Course material menu)
S38.03.note: The plan says the user picks a subject, but the code only has a free text field with a placeholder of examples; the Course material menu appears only when the account has at least one project.
steps: Type the subject into "What are you studying?". There is no list of subjects to pick from; the subject is typed.
If you have projects, open the "Course material" menu and pick "From project: <name>" (or "None").
Click "Start studying" and check that the chat title starts with the mode label and the subject, and the indicator shows "Studying: <subject>".
S38.03.where: Sidebar > Study > "What are you studying?" (and "Course material" when projects exist)

S38.04.note: The level is applied through LEVEL_INSTRUCTIONS in apps/web/features/study/lib/study-session.ts, which the server sends to the model, so the tutor's behaviour change is only seen in the chat reply.
steps: Open the "Where you are with it" menu. The options are "New to it" (default), "Some background" and "Know it well".
Pick "Know it well", type a subject, click "Start studying".
In the new chat, check that the tutor skips the basics and uses precise vocabulary, compared with a session started at "New to it", which defines every term first.
S38.04.where: Sidebar > Study > "Where you are with it"
